parameters.help_en: The call center ID
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫中心 id
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The agent ID. It must be a 3- to 10-digit positive integer
parameters.help_zh: 座席工号；正整数，取值3-10位数字
parameters.name: cno

parameters.help_en: The agent name. The name must be URL-encoded in UTF-8
parameters.help_zh: 座席姓名；需进行UTF-8格式的URLEncode编码
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The agent's area code
parameters.help_zh: 座席所属区号
parameters.name: area_code

parameters.help_en: Determines if the agent is active. Valid values: `1` (active) and `0` (inactive). The default is `1`
parameters.help_zh: 是否激活；取值0或1，取值说明 0：不激活，1激活，默认激活
parameters.name: active

parameters.help_en: The agent's permission level. Valid values: `1` (supervisor) and `0` (agent). The default is `0`
parameters.help_zh: 座席权限；取值1或0，取值说明 1：班长席，0：普通座席，默认为0 普通座席
parameters.name: power

parameters.help_en: The agent's calling permission. Valid values: `0` (unlimited), `1` (domestic long distance), `2` (local), and `3` (internal calls). The default is `0`
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫权限；取值说明 0：无限制，1：国内长途，2：国内本市，3：内部呼叫，默认无限制
parameters.name: call_power

parameters.help_en: The wrap-up time in seconds. The default is 10
parameters.help_zh: 整理时间；单位秒数，默认10秒
parameters.name: wrapup

parameters.help_en: Determines if the agent can make outbound calls. Valid values: `1` (allowed) and `0` (not allowed). The default is `1`
parameters.help_zh: 是否允许外呼；取值说明 0：不允许，1：允许，默认允许
parameters.name: is_ob

parameters.help_en: The caller ID rule. Valid values: `1` (default), `2` (random), `3` (by area code), and `4` (dynamic caller ID). The default is `1`
parameters.help_zh: 外显规则；取值：1:默认 2:随机 3:按区号 4 动态外显 ，默认值为1
parameters.name: ob_clid_type

parameters.help_en: The pass-through number. This can be an enterprise trunk number or a pre-configured caller ID number. This parameter is required if `ObClidType` is set to `2` or `3`
parameters.help_zh: 透传号码；可传入企业中继号码或设置好的客户侧外显号码，当obClidType值为2或3时必选
parameters.name: ob_clid

parameters.help_en: The caller ID properties, specified as a JSON string. This parameter is required if `ObClidType` is set to `4`. The JSON string can contain the following fields: `isMatchCapital` determines if phone numbers of provincial capitals are matched (`1`: yes, `0`: no); `areaCodeRule` sets the area code matching rule (`1`: agent area code, `2`: customer's area code); and `isRandom` enables a random caller ID (`1`: yes)
parameters.help_zh: 外显属性；取值：{"isMatchCapital":0,"areaCodeRule":1,"isRandom":1}；obClidType=4时，isMatchCapital表示是否匹配省会号码，1是 0否，areaCodeRule表示区号匹配规则，1座席区号 2客户号码区号 ;isRandom 随机外显
parameters.name: ob_clid_property

parameters.help_en: Determines if inbound calls are recorded. Valid values: `1` (record) and `0` (do not record). The default is `1`
parameters.help_zh: 呼入是否录音；取值说明 0：不录用，1：录音，默认录音
parameters.name: ib_record

parameters.help_en: Determines if outbound calls are recorded. Valid values: `1` (record) and `0` (do not record). The default is `1`
parameters.help_zh: 外呼是否录音；取值说明 0：不录音，1：录音，默认录音
parameters.name: ob_record

parameters.help_en: The IDs of skills assigned to the agent, separated by commas (,). If this parameter is set, you must also specify `SkillLevels`
parameters.help_zh: 所选的技能id；可选择多个，多个之间使用英文标点逗号间隔.例如:"1,2,3"；传入skillIds时，需要同时传入skillLevels
parameters.name: skill_ids

parameters.help_en: The proficiency level for each skill in `SkillIds`, separated by commas (,). The levels must correspond to the skill IDs in order. A smaller value indicates a higher proficiency level. For example, if `SkillIds` is "1,2,3" and `SkillLevels` is "5,1,1", the agent's proficiency for skill 1 is 5, for skill 2 is 1, and for skill 3 is 1
parameters.help_zh: 所选的技能的等级；值越小技能越高，多个间用英文标点逗号间隔。(与技能id相对应) 例如:"5,1,1"表示技能id为1的等级是5; 技能id为2的等级是1; 技能id为3的等级是1
parameters.name: skill_levels

parameters.help_en: Determines if ASR transcription is enabled. Valid values: `1` (enabled) and `0` (disabled). The default is `0`
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启ASR转写；取值说明：0：不开启，1：开启，默认不开启
parameters.name: is_asr

parameters.help_en: Determines if agent quality inspection is enabled. Valid values: `1` (enabled) and `0` (disabled). The default is `1`
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启座席质检；取值说明：0：不开启，1：开启，默认开启
parameters.name: is_quality_check

parameters.help_en: The type of URL to return for the WebRTC softphone. Valid values: `0` (enterprise default), `1` (public domain name), `2` (private line domain name), `3` (public IP), and `4` (private line IP)
parameters.help_zh: webrtc软电话返回地址；取值说明：0：企业默认 1：公网域名 2：专线域名 3：公网IP 4：专线IP
parameters.name: webrtc_url_type

parameters.help_en: Determines if outbound caller ID memory is enabled. Valid values: `1` (enabled) and `0` (disabled). The default is `1`
parameters.help_zh: 外呼主叫记忆开关；取值说明：0：关闭 1：开启；默认开启
parameters.name: is_ob_remember
